Class RenderedPrompt

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.prompt.core.RenderedPrompt
public final class RenderedPrompt extends Object
============================================================================ RenderedPrompt — the fully-expanded, ready-to-send prompt artifact. ============================================================================ This is the *output* of the Prompt Engine's render pipeline. It contains everything the LLM adapter needs to make a completion call, plus everything the Provenance layer needs to reconstruct this exact call later. Immutability guarantee ---------------------- Once created, a RenderedPrompt is never mutated. It is passed by reference through the AgentNode → LLM Adapter → Provenance chain. The contentHash field enables the audit layer to detect any tampering that might occur between creation and storage. Relationship to the platform ---------------------------- - Created by TemplateRenderer after variable resolution. - Consumed by the LLM adapter (langchain4j ChatModel). - Snapshotted by ProvenanceService as part of every agent execution record. - If rendering fails, an ErrorPayload with type LLMError or ValidationError is emitted on the node's error output port — consistent with the Error Channel pattern from the blueprint.
